newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD 10,000 METRES CHAMPION GEBRSELASSIE.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD 10,000 METRES CHAMPION GEBRSELASSIE.

text.p: Profile of Haile Gebrselassie, who won the world 10,000 metres title on Wednesday.
Recaptured his 10,000 metres world record last month in Oslo with a time of 26 minutes 31.32 seconds. Also holds the 5,000 metres world record in 12:44.39.
Won the last two 10,000 metres world titles. Sought rare Olympic double last year in Atlanta but withdrew from the 5,000 metres after sustaining severe blisters on his feet while winning the 10,000.
Broke compatriot Daniel Komen's two mile world best in 8:01.08 last May in Hengelo, narrowly missing $1 million in prize money for breaking the eight minute mark.
